verdict.rationale: Bland documents event-driven triggers that start agent workflows automatically, such as calling a customer when a support case is created, and batch call campaigns from CSV uploads. Neither is described as time-based or recurring scheduling, so the evidence only touches the edge of the story. Missing for 10: cron or recurring schedule configuration, time-based triggers, scheduled batch campaigns, any API, CLI or MCP method for creating schedules, and independent corroboration.
